title: Governed generated refresh exact-head authority and bounded Remote MCP recovery

phases.objective: Keep generated-artifact-refresh as the sole exact-head mutating maintenance authority, require one scoped trusted repository identity for branch APIs, checkout-persisted pushes, and verifier dispatch, and preserve deterministic bounded Remote MCP recovery plus fail-closed schema/docs coverage.

e2e_journeys.actor: trusted generated-artifact dispatcher and repository governance reviewer
e2e_journeys.entrypoint: workflow_dispatch of the registered generated-artifact writer with a governed feature branch, exact current SHA, registered recipe, typed confirmation, and REPO_AUTOSYNC_TOKEN repository identity
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: The writer fails before checkout when the trusted credential is absent, rejects stale or protected targets, auto-selects Work Map self-hosting before Remote MCP recovery and frontend fallback, regenerates only its registered outputs, proves determinism and currentness, commits with one normal fast-forward push authenticated by the scoped repository writer identity, and dispatches read-only exact-head verification through that same identity so pull-request checks remain observable.
steps: Validate target_ref, expected_head_sha, typed confirmation, protected-branch rejection, and workflow-dispatch-only authority before mutation.
Require REPO_AUTOSYNC_TOKEN before checkout and refuse github.token or GITHUB_TOKEN as a repository-writer fallback.
Use the same scoped repository identity for branch API operations, persisted checkout credentials used by the generated-artifact tool push, and recipe-specific verifier dispatch.
Classify the recipe with Work Map self-hosting priority, canonical Remote MCP currentness probing, and frontend fallback without granting an alternate writer authority.
For Remote MCP recovery, run the canonical generator twice and require identical SHA-256 output hashes.
Require the candidate write set to contain only the outputs registered for the resolved recipe.
Run canonical currentness and contract tests before committing.
Re-read the remote branch against expected_head_sha immediately before one normal push and never force-push.
Dispatch the registered read-only verifier with target_ref and the resulting exact head SHA.
Treat maintenance-tool source changes under http-generic-api/scripts as covered only when a real scripts/test-* or other accepted schema/docs/test companion exists.
assertions: generated-artifact-refresh remains the sole registered mutating maintenance tool for generated state in this flow.
The writer fails before checkout when REPO_AUTOSYNC_TOKEN is unavailable.
Branch API mutation, checkout-persisted repository push, and verifier dispatch all use REPO_AUTOSYNC_TOKEN; github.token and GITHUB_TOKEN are forbidden as writer fallbacks.
A generated follow-up commit must not depend on the default github-actions bot credential path that can suppress the pull-request workflow cycle needed for exact-head verification.
remote_mcp_write_scope_refresh can write exactly the JSON inventory and Markdown inventory and no other repository path.
auto routing preserves Work Map self-hosting priority, then canonical Remote MCP stale-state recovery, then frontend fallback.
Remote MCP generation is executed twice and SHA-256 equality is required before currentness and contract verification.
The Remote MCP verifier is read-only and workflow-dispatch verification is bound to target_ref plus expected_head_sha.
main and Production remain forbidden mutation targets and force push remains forbidden.
Schema/docs coverage recognizes http-generic-api/scripts/test-* companions without exempting maintenance tooling from coverage.

No provider call, live database access, migration apply, deployment, live UEACP capture, or credential value in evidence is authorized; the scoped repository token is used only for the declared GitHub repository identity.

phases.objective: Observe one explicitly authorized feature-branch refresh produce a trusted-identity commit, trigger the expected pull-request verification cycle, converge its bounded outputs, and pass exact-head read-only verification.

Exercise missing trusted identity, stale heads, protected refs, unexpected dirty paths, nondeterministic generation, currentness-probe failure, concurrent branch movement, and verification-dispatch failure while preserving fail-closed behavior.
This repository-maintenance bootstrap performs no live provider or deployment canary.
The writer rejects protected branches and this contract grants no Production, migration, provider, database, or live-capture authority.
